shared_elements: linear incised/engraved marks on a rock surface
rows of repeated short vertical strokes (crew-strokes in A, rune-like staves in B)
linear border/edge arrangement of marks along the margin
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic linear marks, and the only real correspondence is the repeated row of short vertical strokes — crew-lines above the boat hulls in A versus rune-like staves in bands in B — plus a tendency for marks to run along the edge of the surface. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a pictorial scene of hulled boats with upcurved prows, human figures with limbs and weapons, and a column of cup-marks, whereas B carries only abstract sign-sequences in framed lines with no figures or objects at all.
